$comment: Machine-readable provenance for Drop In assets. The Phase 0 provenance file is absent from this branch, so Task 4 records its new surface source here without inventing or duplicating terrain records from the unmerged licence branch.

encoding.note: Resized and supercompressed to meet the 512 KB per-asset KTX2 budget in docs/drop-in-v2/BUDGETS.md; UASTC at the native 2K resolution produced ~5.6 MB per map.

excludedFiles.reason: Snow albedo carries almost no signal, and a photographic albedo fights the PeakCam poster palette.
